elena: quick pingmy docs PR for the runtime config reference is blocked. the SDK snippet shows `max_context_tokens: 4096` but runtime currently enforces 8192. preview failed on linkcheck and we need runtime/SDK confirmation before the docs release window closes.

docs-ci-bot: preview failed render error in /docs/reference/runtime-config.md line 15. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1998765432

omar: i recall we increased the model context limit in the runtime to support longer evals; commit c12d4f changed the enforced max to 8192 on 2026-03-10. SDK default stayed at 4096 to avoid memory spikes on older clients. i'll link the commit.

elena: thanks. two options: update the examples to explicitly set `max_context_tokens: 8192` and call out that older SDKs may cap at 4096, or hold the docs until SDK bump lands. release window is ~12h so leaning to explicit snippet + migration note.

rachel: agree with explicit snippet. also add a short note under "Compatibility" that clients running SDK < 2.4 will silently truncate contexts above 4096 unless upgraded. that will prevent unexpected user confusion.

docs-ci-bot: preview retried (job 10012). link: https://ci.internal/preview/10012

elena: updated the snippet and added the compatibility note. snippet:
```
// example
client.infer({
  model: "robin-14b",
  max_context_tokens: 8192
})
```
PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5367

rachel: wording looks good. small suggestion: add one sentence about the memory/cost tradeoff when using larger contexts.

elena: added the sentence. preview passed. docs-ci-bot: preview succeeded - artifacts: https://ci.internal/preview/10012/artifacts

omar: LGTM. i'll follow up with SDK owners to prioritize a compatibility bump. filing runtime issue to track alignment: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/issues/822

elena: great, merging after a short hold to watch errors. thanks all! :shipit:
